title: Requirements for Transferees
intro: For students coming from another college or university. Your earned credits will be evaluated before you enroll.

documents.name: Transcript of records for evaluation
documents.note: Original copy stamped "Copy for Riverside College"

documents.name: Completed transfer application form
documents.note: Get a copy at the Registrar's Office

steps.title: Request your documents
steps.description: Ask your previous school for your transcript, honorable dismissal and good moral certificate.

steps.title: Submit the transfer application
steps.description: Bring all requirements to the Registrar's Office.

steps.title: Credit evaluation
steps.description: The program head evaluates which subjects can be credited. This takes about one week.

steps.title: Confirm and enroll
steps.description: Review your evaluation with the Registrar and pay the enrollment fees.
